title: Backcasting from Equitable Global Cyber AI Governance: What Must Change in Trust Infrastructure?

original_idea.body:
# Backcasting from Equitable Global Cyber AI Governance: What Must Change in Trust Infrastructure?

**Problem:** Equitable global governance of dual-use cyber AI requires Global South defenders to have equivalent access to frontier AI tools as US/EU defenders. Working backward from this goal identifies structural trust infrastructure gaps.

**Direction:** Define the equitable governance success state (equivalent verified access for equivalent-quality defenders regardless of geography). Work backward: what institutional recognition mechanisms, credential translation systems, and local verification infrastructure must exist? Map current gaps by region. Prioritize 3 most impactful interventions.

**Why it matters:** Without equitable access, dual-use governance creates a two-tier world where the most vulnerable defenders are least equipped. This analysis provides a concrete roadmap for bridging the gap.

**Relevant context:** Global South equity problem; OpenAI Trusted Access; India AI Impact Summit 2026; BRICS AI governance.
